redFirst.basis: `python3 plugins/audit/tests/test_detect_plan_skip.py --selftest` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1 with 7 of 42 collected tests failing an assertion, the task's own among them (named by --case, HEAD's own tests green on HEAD's code), each passing with the working tree's implementation - sa1 (house FAIL): SELFTEST FAILED: 35/42 cases passed; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, OLDPWD; dependencies linked from the project root, entry by entry as symlinks: node_modules - .cache, .vite, .vite-temp are not linked and a new entry a runner makes beside the links stays in the throwaway, but a write into a linked entry lands in the project's own node_modules and is not watched; no .npmrc to carry or drop

outcome.technical: Standing high-risk approval, armed and revoked only by the owner's own prompt. hooks/_config.py gains a section (STANDING_ARM_KEYWORD '#approve-high-risk', STANDING_REVOKE_KEYWORD '#revoke-high-risk', actions risk.standing.armed / revoked / used, STANDING_VIA 'owner-prompt'): owner_prompt(data) returns the `prompt` of a payload whose hook_event_name is UserPromptSubmit and that names no agent_id, and nothing else (not user_prompt, message, tool_response or a transcript_path file); keyword_typed (whole word, case-insensitive); standing_prompt_act (revoke wins over arm in one prompt); standing_entry / standing_use_entry (journal entry builders); standing_approval(rows) (the last owner-written arm/revoke row decides; uses = use rows whose details.reason cites THIS arming row's hash prefix); journal_lib(). detect-plan-skip.py main() calls _record_standing, which appends the row through _journal_io.append_why with the prompt verbatim in details.reason, claims the append for the session (record_plugin_write) and prints ARMED/REVOKED or 'NOT armed' when the row did not land. drive-phase.py: the high-risk step still checks confirmed_in_advance first (unchanged); for a task it does not cover, new standing_use() reads the trail through _loader.load_hooks_config's standing_approval, takes _tree_stamp.scope_digest of the task's files (excluding _evio.recorded_paths), appends one risk.standing.used row (taskId, phaseId, basis 'scope digest sha256:...', reason citing the arming row) through append_from_cli_why, and only then marks the task confirmed; not armed, an untakeable digest or an unwritten row returns None and the decide-high-risk decision is asked as before. Doctor: _doctor_trail.check_standing_approval (OK 'ARMED since <ts> ... (row <hash>); N commit(s) went through it' or 'not armed ...; last revoked <ts>'; WARNING when the reader or journal cannot be read), wired into audit-doctor.diagnose after check_journal. record-risk-confirmation.py: docstring paragraph only, saying how the standing approval sits beside it; its behaviour is unchanged. README: hook list entry, a new guarantees row (saying what is NOT held: `audit-journal.py append --via owner-prompt` can forge a row and nothing tells it apart), the decide-high-risk invariant row, and the /audit:phase row. commands/phase.md: step 1 now names the two keywords, and the file is 3 bytes smaller than HEAD (5226 -> 5223); measure-context --gate prints run form 3986/4000; the RENDER_POINTER 'in your own reply' and the bold VERBATIM pointer _refs requires are both kept. Tests: test_detect_plan_skip sa1a-sa1d, sa1, sa2a-sa2c, sa2 (42/42); test_drive_phase sh-block sh1a-sh1d, sh1 (5/5 via --stage sh-block); test_audit_doctor sx1a-sx1c, sx1 (173/173). Red on HEAD code, all as assertion failures: detect_plan_skip 35/42, drive sh-block 2/5, doctor 169/173. Mutations, run in a scratch copy of plugins/audit (the shared tree untouched): owner_prompt also reading user_prompt/message -> sa1a, sa1b, sa1c, sa1 red; owner_prompt always '' (over-fire the other way) -> sa1c, sa1d, sa1, sa2a red; _owner_written always True -> sa1b, sa1 red; arm checked before revoke -> sa2c red; uses counting every use row -> sx1b, sx1 red. Full sweep: 334/334 files ok, 16156 cases, exit 0 (the first sweep went red on test__refs rt1 because an earlier phase.md edit had dropped 'in your own reply'; that was fixed and both runs went green). ruff: All checks passed; vermin: minimum 3.7. bench-hooks --gate within budget on 3.14.7 only, no other interpreter found. No new import, so the _deps module map did not change. Out of scope and left alone: audit-status.py does not show the approval (the description asks for doctor and status, but status is not in this task's files); hooks.json and test_record_risk_confirmation.py needed no change; PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md's detect-plan-skip section does not describe the keywords; the existing plan bypass's _prompt_text still reads user_prompt and message, the same kind of gap this task closes for the standing approval.
outcome.descriptive: The owner can type #approve-high-risk once and high-risk commits then go through without a mid-run question, each one journaled with its task and scope digest; #revoke-high-risk turns it off, doctor shows whether it is armed and how many commits used it, and the per-phase confirmation works as before.
